name: r2-oproj-t224-epi-ab
author: solx-loop
description: E2/H14 tested and refuted. The residual C read costs a near-constant 2.3-3.4 us in the CUTLASS sm100 2SM TMA epilogue (2048..8192 tokens). It is not C-load latency: deeper C pipelines, an L2 prefetch of the C tile and a delayed C issue all leave it unchanged. Mainloop depth was the only lever (5 -> 6 stages = -3 us), and the parent already has 6; a 7th stage bought with a 128x16 epilogue tile does not help.
